svg.title: FileSquid v2 mockup 25: File panel states
svg.desc: The four file panel tabs share one treatment for loading, empty, no-match and error states. Loading: File facts with placeholder rows and a busy label. Empty: Audit log with no entries in the chosen time range and a control to widen it. No match: Descriptive filtered by a word that matches nothing, with Clear filter and Add property. Error: PROV-O could not load, with the error code and operation id, Retry, and a link to the journal.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Charter', 'Palatino Linotype', serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One treatment for every tab: the header, tabs and filter stay in place; the state replaces the table.
